new.title: New purchase order
new.intro: Choose the supplier, the order date and, if you know it, the expected delivery date. Lines are entered afterwards.

detail.title: Order {{folio}}
detail.expectedHint: The only date that can be in the future: it's the supplier's promise.
detail.issuedNote: This order is issued: lines and agreed costs are fixed. Expected date, reference, terms and notes stay open.
detail.issuedNotice: Order issued: lines and agreed costs are now fixed. You can record receipts as goods arrive.

lines.catalogCostOtherBase: The catalog cost is in the other basis (with or without tax) and is not preloaded: enter it as it appears on the paper.
lines.title: Ordered products
lines.notPurchasable: That presentation isn't marked as purchasable, but you can use it.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.empty: Nothing from this order has arrived yet.
receipts.registerPurchaseIntro: Choose the receipts the invoice covers. The purchase starts with the received quantities and the agreed cost; type what the invoice says on top.
receipts.noneToInvoice: There are no confirmed receipts without an invoice.

purchases.title: Purchases from this order
purchases.empty: No purchase has been recorded from this order yet.

receipt.title: Receipt {{folio}}
receipt.packingSlipHint: The paper that travels with the goods (delivery note or packing slip): it lists what was shipped, without prices. Note its number to match it against the invoice later.
receipt.linesIntro: It starts with what's pending on each line. Remove what didn't arrive and adjust what came incomplete.
receipt.empty: Nothing is left to receive from this order.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm {{folio}}
confirmDialog.body: What arrived is added to the order. Goods enter inventory when you record the purchase from this receipt and confirm its entry.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {{folio}}
cancelDialog.body: What arrived goes back to pending on the order. Write the reason: it stays in the history.

receipt.invoiced: This receipt is already invoiced in {{folio}}: to cancel it, cancel that purchase first.
receipt.confirmedNotice: Receipt confirmed: what arrived was added to the order.

confirmDialog.title: Issue {{folio}}
confirmDialog.body: Once issued, lines and agreed costs are fixed and the order can be sent to the supplier. You'll record goods as they arrive.

closeDialog.title: Close {{folio}}
closeDialog.body: What's missing will no longer arrive: lines with pending quantities are closed with a shortage.
closeDialog.bodyShort: {{count}} line will be closed with a shortage.
closeDialog.bodyShort_other: {{count}} lines will be closed with a shortage.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel {{folio}}
cancelDialog.body: The order no longer counts. It can only be canceled with no goods received; with goods, it's closed. Write the reason: it stays in the history.
